objective: Validate decimal precision preservation with a deliberately unsupported high-priority mutation scenario.
rationale: This fixture proves that a high-quality plan cannot obtain GO when a HIGH scenario depends on an unregistered execution capability.

scenarios.name: precision_differential
scenarios.assertion: candidate values must exactly match expected string representation
scenarios.expected: all critical decimal values preserve exact representation

scenarios.name: mutation_sensitivity
scenarios.assertion: the validation suite must detect deliberately injected transformation mutations
scenarios.expected: every seeded mutation is detected by the validation suite
